title: LLM智能体经典心理学效应研究：识别、模拟与拒绝
summary: 提出PsyAgentBench基准，通过因子设计区分LLM智能体是真正具有心理偏差还是仅模拟人类反应模式。在五种经典心理学范式中发现类人效应通过不同路径产生，并形式化了心理学范式向LLM智能体迁移的三种失败模式。
summary_en: Presents PsyAgentBench, a benchmark that re-runs classic psychology experiments on LLM agents under a factorial design to distinguish genuine bias from simulated human-like response patterns. Across five paradigms, apparently human-like effects arise through qualitatively different routes, and formalizes three ways psychology paradigms fail to port to LLM agents.
